scope: 19 missing recognisable UK security remote-keypad families; photographed identification references, not new emulators or complete menu mappings. Existing 441 pictured entries were checked for overlap.

known_image_quality_limits: RISCO Elegant original is 270×255; kept at genuine source resolution.
Honeywell CP046-00 source has a large blank border; the real product crop is 348×305. Neither image was synthetically enhanced.
retrieval_notes: Ajax public /api/cdn-img route returned HTTP 400. The same image filenames were successfully downloaded with HTTP 200 from the manufacturer public /cdn/upload/ path, confirmed from the manufacturer product page CDN structure.
Honeywell MK8 official image filename says mk7; image is the correct uncovered MK8 rectangular-key fascia, confirmed visually against its official product-page assignment.
Only blank border cropping was performed on four Ajax images and the Honeywell TouchCenter image. Original bytes, crop rectangles and hashes are preserved under research/.
